Thanks again for the call this morning — great to understand the Payments.ai routing use case and the bursty ACH-like peaks you mentioned. Quick recap + proposed next steps: 

- Goal: run a dedicated capacity sizing workshop to confirm throughput (tokens/sec) and tail-latency targets, then pair that with a short demo of the inference pipeline and caching options.
- Prep items we need from your side: representative load profile (per-minute request counts + avg token lengths) and any strict P95/P99 latency SLOs.
- Suggested workshop length: 60–75 minutes (throughput deep dive + questions).

Proposed time slots (all PT):
- Monday 21 May, 10:00–11:15
- Tuesday 22 May, 14:00–15:15
- Thursday 24 May, 09:00–10:15

If those don't work, please send 2–3 options that fit your calendar and we9ll lock one. I9ve cc9d Ben (solutions) and Priyom (ops) — they9ll run the sizing portion and capture the mutual action plan.

Attachments: sample mutual action plan attached for reference.

Thanks,

Mina Haddad
